events.title: Engelbert Humperdinck: The Celebration Tour
events.description: The legendary 'King of Romance' brings his celebration tour to The Star Gold Coast for a night of timeless ballads and classic hits like 'Release Me' and 'The Last Waltz'.

events.title: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox — The Future Is Vintage Tour
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: HOTA welcomes the internationally loved vintage-pop phenomenon, known for reworking modern hits into jazz, swing, soul, and retro-inspired arrangements in their new 'The Future is Vintage' tour.

events.title: Free Breakdancing Workshops — Hip Hop Heroes
events.description: The Hip Hop Heroes offer free, all-ages breakdancing workshops daily from 6–11 July. This cultural and movement experience is open to everyone interested in learning hip hop dance.

events.title: Sleeping Beauty — The Pantomime
events.description: A family-friendly pantomime at Spotlight Theatre Basement, Benowa, featuring comedy, music, and audience participation, with multiple morning and afternoon sessions running until 11 July.

events.title: SURFACE Festival — Street Art, Murals & Creative Precinct
events.description: Miami and its neighbours transform into a vibrant hub of public art, community events, and live music, featuring over 50 murals, workshops, and street performances throughout July.

events.title: 'This Moment' — White Rabbit Collection at HOTA Gallery
events.description: This exhibition gathers 35 artworks from 25 leading contemporary Chinese artists, offering a powerful snapshot of creativity and culture across 21st-century China, with public talks and tours available.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart — Children's Gallery at HOTA
events.description: An immersive children's exhibition by First Nations artist Lisa Sorbie Martin, bringing memories of her Torres Strait childhood to life through ocean-inspired art and interactive play, connecting families with First Nations culture.

events.title: Gold Coast Chamber Orchestra — French & Russian Traditions
events.description: An intimate chamber performance by the Gold Coast Chamber Orchestra at Bond University, celebrating the lyrical beauty and rich colours of French and Russian musical traditions.

events.title: Tom Gleeson: Out of Touch
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: One of Australia's sharpest comedians, Tom Gleeson, brings his latest stand-up show, 'Out of Touch,' to HOTA for a night of dry wit and no-nonsense comedy.

events.title: Sword Fight VIII — Historical Fencing Tournament
events.location: The Vonda Youngman Community Centre, Tamborine Mountain
events.description: A Historical Fencing (HEMA) tournament showcasing Australia's best fencers in disciplines like Longsword and Rapier, free for spectators, and set in the scenic Gold Coast Hinterland.

events.title: Rumble on the Beach — Skateboarding Championship
events.datetime: Thu 9 – Sun 12 Jul, from 9:00 AM daily
events.location: Elanora Skate Park & Pizzey Park Skatepark, Miami
events.description: A free skateboarding championship event featuring top riders and youth competitions, showcasing genuine skate subculture and action-sport energy across two Gold Coast skateparks.

events.title: Eco Arts — Nature-Based Artmaking
events.description: A hands-on, outdoor creative experience where participants, especially kids, can make nature-based artworks using flowers, rocks, and other natural materials in Tallebudgera's Schuster Park.

events.title: Christmas in July — D'Arcy Arms Irish Pub
events.location: D'Arcy Arms Irish Pub, Gold Coast
events.description: Gold Coast's historic D'Arcy Arms Irish Pub transforms into a festive wonderland, offering a two-course Christmas in July feast with roast turkey, pork, and ham; pre-booking required.

events.title: Dinomania at Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
events.description: Embark on an immersive trail to uncover prehistoric creatures, with daily shows, meet-and-greets, face painting, and craft stations, all included with sanctuary admission.

events.title: NAIDOC Colour Run
events.location: City of Gold Coast Chambers, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A festive, community-spirited NAIDOC Week celebration featuring a free colour run at the City of Gold Coast Chambers, open to all for participation.

events.title: Adventure Day (Outdoor Play & Nature Activities)
events.description: Kids can join outdoor play and nature-based activities at Gibson Park in Tallebudgera Valley, offering a wonderful chance to explore the hinterland and connect with nature.
